candidates.title: Anthropic Files Confidentially for Landmark IPO
candidates.description: Anthropic confidentially filed S-1 paperwork with the SEC for a historic initial public offering, targeting a valuation of over $900 billion following explosive enterprise revenue growth.
candidates.significance: This marks the largest-ever planned IPO for an independent artificial intelligence laboratory, signaling a monumental milestone in public-market funding of frontier AI companies.

candidates.title: Senator Sanders Introduces American AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act
candidates.description: U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders introduced the American AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act, proposing a one-time 50% equity tax on frontier AI companies to seed a national wealth fund offering public voting rights and dividends.
candidates.significance: This bill is the first major legislative proposal in the United States to socialize AI equity directly, creating a framework to distribute AI-driven economic gains directly to the public.

candidates.title: Arizona Utility Proposes 45% Electricity Surcharge for AI Data Centers
candidates.description: Arizona's largest utility provider formally proposed a new rate structure that applies a 45% electricity surcharge on AI data centers to offset grid expansion costs and rising local power consumption.
candidates.significance: This is the first major U.S. utility proposal of its scale to target AI power consumption, establishing a critical rate-making precedent for handling AI data center energy footprints.

candidates.title: Florida Attorney General Sues OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman
candidates.description: The Florida Attorney General filed an 83-page lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, alleging negligence and a failure to enforce adequate safety protocols on public LLM models.
candidates.significance: This lawsuit marks one of the first state-level consumer protection actions targeting generative AI leadership directly over the safety and downstream real-world consequences of public AI systems.
